# Other people's work

Three files here are not ours. They are the GitHub and Ko-fi marks,
used in the settings window to link to the repository and to the
author's Ko-fi page — which is what they are for.

They come from [Simple Icons](https://simpleicons.org), whose own work
is CC0; the marks themselves belong to GitHub, Inc. and Ko-fi Labs,
Inc. respectively, and are used here to point at those services and
nothing else. The only change is a white fill, since the settings
window is dark and Qt's SVG renderer does not inherit a colour.

The icons under `assets/pages/` are not ours either, and carry their
own note. Nothing else under `assets/` is third-party: see the licence
note in the README.

## The wallpaper behind the screenshots

`screenshot-background.jpg` is the background the three pictures in the
README were taken against. It is here so they can be taken again and
match: a screenshot of a desktop is a screenshot of somebody's
wallpaper, and without this one the next set would not look like the
last.

It is [Grayscale Photo of Clouds](https://www.pexels.com/photo/grayscale-photo-of-clouds-156986/)
from Pexels, under their
[Creative Commons licence](https://www.pexels.com/creative-commons-images/):
free for commercial and non-commercial use, no attribution required —
though it is a nice thing to do, which is what this paragraph is — and
free to edit.

Chosen for a reason worth writing down: it has local contrast where the
dock sits. A wallpaper that is flat there, however pretty, leaves the
dock invisible and the blur impossible to see. `context.md` carries the
line that measures it.
